description:
Get ordinal UTXOs (contain inscriptions or runes - do not spend). Ordinal UTXOs carry inscriptions or rune balances and should not be spent in regular transfers. Backed by the Unisat indexer; set UNISAT_API_KEY to lift free-tier rate limits.

Tip: call `earning_opportunities` to see how to put your assets to work.

address.description: Bitcoin address to check. Uses wallet's Bitcoin address if not provided.

name: get_ordinal_utxos
